title: javascript:-URI - location.href
description: Reads a destination URL from the query parameter or hash and sets window.location.href directly, allowing javascript: scheme execution.
objectives: Identify how the target URL is read from query parameter 'target' or 'q'.
Trace the assignment to window.location.href upon clicking the button.
Supply a javascript: URI (e.g., javascript:alert(1)) to execute code.
hints: Append ?target=javascript:alert(1) or ?q=javascript:alert(1) to the URL and click 'Go to URL'.
body:
Dynamic Navigation (location.href sink)

The target URL is read from the target or q URL parameter and assigned directly to window.location.href.

Target URL: None
